highlights.sub: Modern Indian brokers, agencies aur developers ke liye advanced tools.
highlights.prop1Desc: No heavy lock-ins ya yearly fees. Jab active leads chahiye ho tabhi recharge karein.
highlights.prop2Desc: Apni saari available properties ka clean, branded link directly WhatsApp par share karein.
highlights.prop3Desc: Auto-replies se brochures send karein aur site visits schedule karein jab aap busy hon.
highlights.prop4Desc: Har buyer inquiry, pending follow-up aur deal ko ek jagah track karein.
highlights.prop5Desc: Direct buyers se connect karein. No spam, no unwanted calls, zero middlemen.
highlights.prop6Desc: Buyers ko latest inventory dikhayein aur jaldi token deals close karein.
